title: Two command-apply paths diverge on tick semantics, breaking the ADR-11 replay contract
evidence:
run_controller.gd:149  func submit_command(cmd: Command) -> EditResult:
run_controller.gd:152  	cmd.tick = _logic_tick
run_controller.gd:153  	var r: EditResult = state.topology.apply_all([cmd])
run_controller.gd:155  		state.action_log.append(cmd)
sim_driver.gd:17  func step(state: RunState, tick: int, cmds: Array) -> SimSnapshot:
sim_driver.gd:23  	var apply_result: EditResult = state.topology.apply_all(cmds)
sim_driver.gd:26  		state.action_log.append(cmd)
run_controller.gd:124  	_logic_tick += 1   (incremented BEFORE driver.step at :127, so cmd.tick records the already-completed tick)
detail: submit_command applies + logs commands OUTSIDE SimDriver.step (which also applies + logs), and cmd.tick is the already-completed tick. Replaying the action_log through step applies each command at a different tick than live — the run won't reproduce (ADR-11).
recommended_fix: Make SimDriver.step the single command-apply + action_log site; have submit_command enqueue for the next step (or stamp cmd.tick with the tick the command applies AT, not the completed one) so live and replay share one path.

title: _snapshot_now passes the live sim RNG into plan_pressure on a per-edit display path (latent ADR-9 break)
evidence:
run_controller.gd _snapshot_now (called by submit_command on every edit):
	var plan: PressurePlan = director.plan_pressure(state.topology.snapshot(),
		state.era.era_id, _logic_tick, state.rng)
scripted_director.gd:  func plan_pressure(_topology, _era_id, _tick, _rng: RandomNumberGenerator)  — _rng is UNUSED today
detail: Every player edit rebuilds the display snapshot by handing the live state.rng to director.plan_pressure. Safe only because ScriptedDirector ignores rng; any rng-consuming director (ADR-7's AiAuditor) would advance the rng off-step and silently break seeded reproducibility.
recommended_fix: Never pass the sim RNG into the display/snapshot path — reuse the last step's PressurePlan for the snapshot, or pass a throwaway RNG, so a display rebuild cannot perturb the seeded sequence.

title: project.godot lost the orientation=0 (landscape) pin mandated by project-context
evidence:
project.godot diff:
-window/handheld/orientation=0   (line deleted)
project-context.md: display/window/handheld/orientation=0 (`SCREEN_LANDSCAPE` — the game is **landscape-only** on mobile and desktop) [RULING — user]  ...and: 'Keep game/project.godot in sync ... (viewport, stretch, renderer, orientation). Changes there are design/architecture decisions, not drive-bys.'
detail: project-context lists window/handheld/orientation=0 (SCREEN_LANDSCAPE) as a locked ruling and says project.godot orientation changes are design decisions, not drive-bys. The diff deleted the explicit pin, desyncing config from the documented landscape-only convention.
recommended_fix: Re-add `window/handheld/orientation=0` under [display] in project.godot to keep it in sync with project-context.md's locked orientation ruling.
